_comment: S8: the 15 dpa reconciliation run.  Same 330 C condition as S2-S7, but
carried to the ACTUAL dose of the measurement instead of the 0.02 dpa
screening dose.  dose_dpa is read per-condition by run_ensemble
(cond.get('dose_dpa', cfg['dose'])), so it overrides --dose.
Why this matters: every conclusion from S1-S7 compared a 0.02 dpa run to
15 dpa data -- a factor of 750 in dose.  The S1 finding that E_a0_conv
cannot satisfy N_100/d_100 and f_100 simultaneously (0/81 points) was
diagnosed at that mismatched dose and may simply not be a real conflict
here.
rho_d is null on purpose so the DESIGN column controls it -- apply_theta
writes condition values AFTER the row loop.
G = 1e-7 dpa/s is the EXPERIMENTAL rate (set 2026-08-16), replacing the
1e-6 accelerated rate that S1-S7 screened at.  t_end = dose/G = 1.5e8 s,
about 14 decades of log-spaced time against the 10 decades of the
screening runs.
This is not a cosmetic change.  Dropping G by 10x at fixed dose gives
every thermal process 10x longer per dpa, so emission, diffusion and
coarsening all gain ground on production -- which is the direction the
reconciliation needs (fewer, larger loops; more cavity growth).  It also
means the S1-S7 screening conclusions were drawn at a dose rate the
measurement never saw, and their PARAMETER RANKINGS may not transfer even
though their mechanisms should.
